_: The owner's tunable parameter and every limit of relentless.py, in data. See design/RimMandrake/relentless_owner_design_2026-10-31.md section 8 for why each number is what it is.

A cool is capped at breaker_cool_max_s: 14400 slept 6 h on the 2026-11-01 jam. breaker_same_cause_opens opens by one cause inside breaker_same_cause_window_s (6 h, that jam's length) are an emergency: a told.jsonl row for breaker_reader, ack due in breaker_ack_min (OP3's default), plus the conductor log and staffing.alarm_item. _staffing: The no-AI filler, design section 13. Rises 3, 5, budget, each step only after a clean reading: hold_s at full stage, min_verdicts blind verdicts in that stage's window, at most max_reject_share rejected, memory never under step_back_mem_gb, no OOM kill, burn at most burn_max_pct_h. foreign_* are what a worker may take from the other seat without pulling its tree.
_circling: RW2, circling.py. Thresholds unmeasured: replay real runs before trusting one. stop stays false until circling_replay.json, written by `circling.py replay --write` from hand-labelled runs on this code and these numbers, shows wrongful stops under false_stop_limit; the flag alone stops nothing.
_help: RW3 in operating_requirements_2026-11-01.md. help_after_circling stops of class circling force one consult; one per item per help_cool_h, a worker's own call included. help_launch_tries runs a consult may die with no answer before the item carries on without it, help_max_s one run's limit, help_wait_s how long a wanted consult may wait for room while it holds the next worker back.
